answer: For a lagoon poll on an anchor at a sculpture's vertex, the server accepts numeric ballots from 0 to 1, rejects values outside that range, and reports their median. If 100 honest ballots are all 0, an attacker needs 101 ballots of 1 to make the median 1. This limits the effect of extreme values, not duplicate identities; a large sybil pool can still dominate.
